items.sentence: On [MASK], Complainant filed an EEO complaint alleging that the Agency discriminated against him and subjected him to a hostile work environment on the bases of sex (male) and in reprisal for prior protected EEO activity when: 1. on November 24, 2020, a co-worker (CW1) claimed to do Voodoo and placed a flower on Complainant’s body; 2. 3. sometime after November 24, 2020, management failed to address Complainant’s concerns regarding the November 24, 2020, incident with CW1 and prevented Complainant from attending management meetings and scheduling operational meetings; and 4. on December 30, 2020, a manager (Manager) paced back and forth, stood over Complainant, and blocked the door when Complainant tried to leave. 2 In support of his allegations regarding Claims (1) and (2), Complainant alleged that he asked CW1 to step back and stay away from him, but CW1 would not, and that CW1 backed him into a corner.
[MASK] noted that he complained to Agency management on November 24 and 28, 2020, and that no action was taken.
The record indicates that, in a [MASK] memorandum, the Interim Federal Security Director (Interim Director) appointed Manager to investigate Complainant’s claims.

Subsequently, and as alleged in Claim (4), [MASK] stated that Manager approached him, demanding that Complainant answer questions about his allegations against CW1, but refused to show Complainant his authorization to investigate the claims.

[MASK] alleged that Manager offered to show the memorandum to Complainant on his computer, but every time Complainant went to look, Manager “would click off the screen to prevent [Complainant’s] view of it.
